attributes.name: Caulky Tarroon
attributes.powers:
Before you act, Caulky Tarroon deals 1 Poison damage to you.

If the check to defeat does not have the Swashbuckling trait, a random character at your location banishes the top card of his deck.

"There's no surer way to end an argument than with a knife between the ribs."—Caulky Tarroon
